g.text: Resumefolio ecosystem — external connections and evidence status
Solid arrows = intended information direction, NOT proof of an active integration.
Dashed arrow = operating dependence. Status labels qualify every external facility.
Browser/file/Git clients are participants, not independent product platforms.
GitHub development tooling is outside this runtime map; no GitHub/LinkedIn/job-board API is assumed.
Source: file 02 scope inventory; file 12 IF-01-IF-08; dated demo evidence.
